1.consolidated_definition: "Piltrafa": (f.) Sustancia o objeto de escasa calidad o valor, sobrante de un material como tela o madera.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Rag or scrap: (f.) Substandard substance or object, leftover from a material such as fabric or wood.
